fact: Burundi Eco reports interior ministry officials announced in July 2024 that under ID for D each person's prints and name are recorded electronically from birth and given a unique lifelong ID number.
system: ID for D (Identite pour le Developpement)

fact: Permanent secretary Valentin Nahimana of the Interior Ministry says a unique identification number with fingerprints will be given to each child at birth, in a health facility or before the civil-status officer, under the ID for D project; a plan, preliminary scope eleven communes.
